verdict.rationale: Snoozing and follow-up reminders are a fair question for an email inbox product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no snooze, scheduled resurfacing, or no-reply reminder capability. Labels for tracking conversation state and webhooks are only building blocks a developer could use to construct such behavior, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies
